description.value: Yunshang Rice Noodle is a Canadian chain rooted in Yunnan's 'crossing-the-bridge' rice noodle tradition, where diners cook fresh meats and vegetables tableside in a slow-simmered, MSG-free bone broth. The Burnaby location at 4500 Kingsway is one of 18 Canadian outlets and also operates under a Yang's Chicken co-brand. Beyond the signature broth noodles, the menu includes specialty soups, cold appetizers, and fried snacks, with unlimited rice noodle refills for dine-in guests.
